name: Zero-noise extrapolation for Bell <ZZ>
task_prompt: Implement zero-noise extrapolation by hand for the Bell-state observable <ZZ> using Qiskit Aer with two-qubit CX depolarizing probability 0.04. Build locally folded circuits with CX replaced by 1, 3, and 5 consecutive CX gates. First obtain exact density-matrix expectations, compute the quadratic Richardson intercept with weights 15/8, -5/4, and 3/8, and verify it is closer to the noiseless value 1 than the scale-1 exact noisy value. Then obtain 50000 seeded-shot parity estimates, report linear and quadratic intercepts with bootstrap uncertainty, and do not make a brittle per-draw improvement assertion. Provide only complete executable Python code. Do not use remote services. Seed random generators, print the requested quantities, and include robust self-tests rather than relying on visual inspection.
